title: Time-bound attestation packager for key rotation and data-residency compliance
creator: Ava Patel
description: Build an automated export/packaging service that produces tamper-evident, time-bound compliance bundles for tenant-level encryption and residency evidence. Each bundle will contain the key rotation chain (signed rotation events), residency assertions (region, storage class, instance IDs), retention policy snapshot, and HSM/KMS attestation signatures. Bundles must be verifiable by external auditors and consumable by internal compliance tools.
technical_notes: Source events: canonical audit stream (audit-log-topic) + rotation events from KMS connector + metadata service for cluster/region mapping.
Integrity model: Merkle-tree over all events in the bundle, root signed by HSM signing key; include per-event hashes and a compact proof for spot-check verification.
Time-bound attestation: include a signed assertion with start_ts and end_ts; optionally anchor timestamp to external time-stamping service for non-repudiation.
Packaging formats: primary JSONL bundle for machine consumption, optional PDF summary for auditors; both include the same signed root and signature metadata.
Storage: write bundles to immutable compliance S3 bucket with object lock; lifecycle rules aligned with tenant retention settings.
Performance: target 95th percentile bundle generation latency < 15 minutes for active rotation windows; support bulk reconstitution jobs for historical windows.
Fallbacks: if HSM signing fails, mark bundle 'unsigned' and enqueue for retry; retain intermediate proof-of-wait state to avoid data loss.
Access controls: bundles accessible only to tenant owners + compliance role via expiring signed URLs; retrieval APIs require MFA for high-sensitivity tenants.
Verification API: lightweight endpoint that accepts a bundle and returns verification status (signature validity, hash consistency, event continuity).

Trade-offs: near-real-time vs. batch. Near-real-time increases cost and HSM signing calls; batch reduces cost but increases latency for audits. Plan hybrid: near-real-time alerts + nightly canonical bundle per tenant.
tasks: Design event enrichment pipeline and schema (audit events + rotation metadata + residency mapping)
Implement Merkle-tree signer service that uses HSM-protected signing key
Build packager service to assemble JSONL bundles + optional PDF summary
Implement immutable storage + lifecycle config for compliance S3 bucket
Create retrieval API with RBAC and expiring signed URLs
Add verification API and end-to-end tests
Integrate with Console: add per-tenant evidence page with download and signature verification
Perform load testing (target concurrent bundles and HSM QPS) and cost estimation
Prepare runbook and incident playbook for signing failures and stale evidence
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant with rotation events in the last 30 days, the system produces a verifiable bundle containing the full rotation chain and residency assertions within 15 minutes of rotation completion
Bundle root is signed by HSM-managed key and verification API returns 'valid' for a canonical test bundle
Bundles are stored in immutable S3 with correct retention policy and audited via retention reports
Console shows evidence download for tenant and allows auditors to verify signature without internal credentials
E2E tests covering signing, storage, access controls, and verification are in CI and pass on merge
Security review sign-off obtained for HSM usage patterns and key handling
